nodes.rationale: Packet revisions 1–5 (M14-PKT-R); a recommendation for Rob's decision, not an approval; local only, nothing executed on any public cluster.
nodes.label: M14 approval packet, revision 5, section 0 (2026-10-24): recommends approving Block A only, a Solana-devnet-first path (fresh devnet test keys, public-faucet SOL, at most 25 devnet SOL, defaults D1–D13, run as the committed Seq-B plan), and holds B1–B4 (bridge, keeper unarmed, live Shenanigans upgrade, devnet frontend canister), C1–C2 (activation, keeper arming) and C3 (real PP mints) for separate approvals. The one decision needed is to approve Block A and say who holds the key for program id 7tj9…, otherwise the fresh devnet program-id envelope (5a) is used, re-pinned and re-reviewed locally before any devnet transaction. The packet authorizes and executes nothing.

nodes.rationale: Finding F1 of the independent tool review, closed in d2dffc9: the removed --i-have-approval flag name claimed more than a text hash proves.
nodes.label: Packet identity pin is NOT approval: on devnet, devnet_ops --execute needs --packet-sha256 with --packet-commit (the sha256 of the packet blob at a named commit, which the working file must equal) plus the devnet genesis hash, and never targets mainnet. The pin only proves which packet text the operator ran against and is recorded in every receipt and write-ahead record; the authority is Rob's explicit approval in chat, recorded by the coordinator before any devnet transaction.

nodes.rationale: Cards M14-TOOL, M14-TOOL-FIX and M14-TOOL-FIX2; LiteSVM gate, pin and write-ahead tests 30/30 and a loopback-validator lifecycle pass; a public-cluster run needs Rob's explicit approval.
nodes.label: devnet_ops operator tool runbook (M14-TOOL, packet RG-4): carries out the Block A ceremony (squads-create, loader-v3 deploy then SetAuthority to the G vault, fund-vault, propose/approve/execute for initialize and ORAO register, readback, verify-bytes); every write is a dry run unless --execute, which is refused off a loopback validator or devnet-with-packet-pin and never reaches mainnet. Interlocks: one send choke point, 1,232-byte measure and simulation before send, proposer as fee payer, time lock read from the cluster clock, only the pinned ELF 8f97e83d…, and a durable fail-closed write-ahead --pending-file with once-only funding. Local preparation only: nothing has touched a public cluster. (State at commit 81841a4: the once-only claim is historical; it was qualified by Codex's later F3 unknown-outcome finding, M14-F3-HOLD, fixed locally afterwards.)

nodes.rationale: Card M14-RUN; 12 runner tests passed after M14-TOOL-FIX2; the runner shares the tool's interlocks and the same --pending-file rule.
nodes.label: devnet_ops flow init|status|next runner for the 39-step M14 plan (M14-RUN): executes one interlocked step at a time (plan order, not before the earliest cluster-clock time, wallet pubkeys matching wallets.json, balanced books before the step, size check and simulation before send), appends per-step JSON receipts with read-backs and conservation identities, and on devnet never fulfils the oracle itself but waits for the real ORAO fulfilment and records latency. The plan data in src/m14_plan.rs is shared with the clock-warped LiteSVM rehearsal and the full plan passes through flow next in LiteSVM on the devnet ORAO binary; no step has been run on a public cluster.

nodes.rationale: Card M14-SIM (commit 9b19045); a local PASS, not a devnet result.
nodes.label: M14 flow plan, Seq-B (packet RG-7): 39 steps over 41.46 days after the G approvals with concrete amounts, first draw request at day 11.45 (day 10.7 is not reachable; 11.36 is the earliest with a deposit of at most 1 SOL), reaching all 15 flow codes with conservation checked after every step. Executed locally in clock-warped LiteSVM on the production ELF and the devnet ORAO binary only: LiteSVM slots and rent are not cluster-realistic, ORAO fulfilment is synthetic and Squads is the stand-in.

nodes.rationale: Cards M14-PRE-ORAO and M14-PRE-SQUADS; the notes also record a loopback-validator lifecycle (real multisig_create_v2, loader-v3 deploy of a small stand-in ELF, SetAuthority to G, verify-bytes) and a correction to commit 6fd55df's 'fmt clean' message.
nodes.label: M14 preflight evidence (2026-10-23), local LiteSVM with the exact devnet ORAO and Squads v4 binaries fetched read-only: the devnet ORAO ELF ran the close-suite flows that pass on the mainnet build (10/10), and real Squads v4 passed 12/12 and forwards the non-vault sponsor signer, so initialize runs through a real vault transaction. vault_transaction_create fits the 1,232-byte packet (1,140 bytes) only when the proposer is also the fee payer; execute is 878 bytes. These are optional hardening only: the required acceptance is the real devnet A4, A5 and A7.

nodes.rationale: M14-TOOL-REV; a fresh Sonnet reviewer with the protocol-security profile; read-only, no builds, network or key reads.
nodes.label: Independent read-only review of the frozen devnet_ops tool and flow runner (commit da3de8c, 2026-10-23): PASS with findings. Nothing lets the tool target mainnet, read an implicit wallet, generate a key or skip the ELF pin or the G-profile gate; F1 (identity-only pin worded as approval), F2 and F3 (the only double-send paths) and F4 (receipt 'done' semantics) had to be fixed before the first devnet --execute, and F5–F9 are low or informational. Fixes went to card M14-TOOL-FIX (commit d2dffc9).

nodes.rationale: M14-TOOL-RECHECK; fresh Sonnet reviewer, read-only; the real-node lifecycle dropped from 120.13 s to 24.25 s once N1 was fixed.
nodes.label: Bounded independent re-check of the F1–F9 fixes (commit d2dffc9, 2026-10-24): PASS with residual findings; F1 and F4 closed, F2 and F3 partial, F5–F9 closed or residual documented. N1 (post-send reads silently ran at finalized because of a nested commitment config), N2 (min_slot not seeded, so a non-idempotent re-run could double-send), N3 (no fsync, torn write-ahead lines skipped) and N4 (pin missing from write-ahead records) were fixed in M14-TOOL-FIX2 and verified by the coordinator's tests, not by a third independent review.

nodes.rationale: Anonymous read-only queries on 2026-10-23; the 70-byte gift memo was first observed in the R1 actor-level replica proof; the served module's lineage is inferred, not proven.
nodes.label: Legacy PP-ledger memo-limit evidence (separate card, not a native M14 gate): the live PP ledger advertises max memo 32 bytes and two live backer mints failed with memo-length traps (80 and 79 bytes) recorded in getMissedBackerMints, with no failed game mints; signup-gift and kickup failures are inferred from source, not shown live. LEG-1 is a local fix on branch fix/pp-ledger-memo-limit, not deployed; no compensation, ledger write or mainnet repair has been made, and LEG-2 recovery is a separate decision with no owner. The native PP path builds its own 32-byte hashed memos and does not depend on this fix.

nodes.rationale: LEG-1 review by a fresh Sonnet reviewer with the Shenanigans PP profile; the rehearsal ran on a local replica only.
nodes.label: Independent read-only review of LEG-1, the legacy PP-ledger memo fix (branch fix/pp-ledger-memo-limit, commit a248793, 2026-10-23): PASS with findings, which is not Codex acceptance and not deployment approval. The diff is memo-only (+8/−8 over seven ledger call sites) with short memos byte-identical; F-1: deploying the fix alone causes payouts (the unchanged observer mints lost signup gifts and in-flight backer retries at the current configuration), so any LEG-2 recovery must reuse the original event ids; F-4: rebuild with --network ic and record the hash before any deploy.
